brief: Matthias was chosen by lot to fill Judas’ place among the twelve apostles. According to Luke’s understanding of apostleship, there had to be twelve true apostles, for they were to be the judges of the twelve tribes of Israel. They had to have been with Jesus throughout his ministry, and they were now to be witnesses of the resurrection. Having been chosen by lot, Matthias was, in effect, chosen by God to make up the Twelve. We know nothing else about him.
